curator_title: The Child from the Parallel World
opening: Late at night, a rustling sound came from my wardrobe. I mustered up the courage to open the cabinet door, and inside was a child. He looked at me and giggled, "Mom, you found me!" I was terrified. Where did this child come from? I told him to leave my house immediately. He cried in fear and kept calling me Mom. Looking closely, he did resemble my ex-husband somewhat. But ever since a miscarriage a few years ago, I had lost my fertility and gotten divorced. He told me he had a twin brother and even called out my and my ex-husband's names. He asked me tearfully, "You really don't remember me?"
solution: Years ago, Earth's orbit shifted and intersected with a parallel world. A fetus in a pregnant woman's womb accidentally shifted into the womb of her counterpart in the parallel world. She mistakenly thought she had miscarried, and her family subsequently broke apart. The other woman mistakenly thought she had twins, and her family was happy from then on. The two worlds were no longer parallel. Eight years later, for some reason, the shift was corrected in an attempt to force the two worlds back into parallel.
canonical_facts: A fetus shifted from one pregnant woman into the womb of her counterpart in the parallel world.
The first woman mistakenly believed that she had miscarried.
Eight years later, the cross-world shift was corrected.
